title: jupyter-workbench workbench-config.json
description: Workbench-wide configuration. Currently defines the agent CLI that `just ws spawn` launches.

agent-cmd.description: Command that launches the workspace agent CLI. `ws spawn` runs it as `<agent-cmd> "<PROMPT.md contents>"` — the prompt is appended as the final positional argument. Examples: 'claude --permission-mode auto', 'kiro-cli chat --agent dlq -a', 'codex'.

_examples.description: Non-functional reference examples, ignored by the tooling.
